curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8110-1-1.pdf (book 1), omr/instructions/8110-1-5.pdf (book 2), omr/instructions/8110-1-2.pdf (book 3), omr/instructions/8110-1-3.pdf (book 4) and omr/instructions/8110-1-4.pdf (book 5; pages 39-42 swap the crane and winch ends, pages 43-44 show every function); the file builds the truck with the crane at the back and the winch at the front

functions.does: The gear on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its long upright axle comes down through the cab to a knob gear, and a shaft with universal joints carries the turn to the front axle, where a small gear slides the steering rack and the portal hubs steer.
functions.source: book: book 4 (the roof gear and upright axle through the cab); book 1 and book 2 (front axle with rack and portal hubs); how it's worked inferred, as the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab turns with the steering.
functions.source: inferred: the book fits it in the dashboard; unsure whether it's linked to the steering
functions.note: unsure whether the steering wheel is linked to the steering or only turns freely

functions.does: Rolling the truck turns the four-cylinder engine: both axles' differentials are linked by shafts with universal joints (permanent four-wheel drive), and the drive turns the crankshaft, so the pistons pump up and down.
functions.source: book: book 1 (front and rear axles with differentials, drive shafts), book 3 (engine); inferred: that the engine is turned by the wheels

functions.does: Each axle's differential lets its two wheels turn at different speeds round corners.
Both portal axles swing about the frame (pendulum suspension), each sprung by two shock absorbers, so the wheels follow rough ground.
functions.source: book: book 1 and book 2 (axles hung on pivots, the extra-hard shock absorbers)
functions.note: inferred which parts are the axle housings; the springs only push back under force

functions.does: The Power Functions motor under the bed drives a gearbox with two driving rings; the yellow and red levers behind the cab set them so the motor works one of four outputs: the front winch, the crane's slewing, the compressor, or a fourth output.
functions.source: book: book 1 steps 13-38 (motor and gearboxes with two driving rings and catches), book 5 pages 43-44 (the lever settings and what each one works)
functions.note: the motor is a control like a crank; which ring and which clutch gear (p321, p325 on one ring, p332, p336 on the other) drives which output isn't read from the file yet; the levers are the catches p512 6641 and p516 6641

functions.does: With the yellow lever up and the red lever down, the motor winds the winch at the front: a shaft runs forward to a worm that turns the 24-tooth gear on the winch drum, raising or lowering the hook.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 43 (top left: lever settings, the winch hook moving up and down), book 5 pages 33-35 (winch with worm, 24-tooth gear and hook)
functions.note: which way each catch moves for each setting is inferred; the hook's rise and fall isn't expressed by the fields

functions.does: With both levers up, the motor slews the crane: a shaft runs back to the crane base, where a worm turns the gear under the turntable, turning the crane round.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 43 (top right: both levers up, the crane turning), book 4 pages 43-48 (crane base with worm and turntable)
functions.note: which way each catch moves for each setting is inferred

functions.does: With the yellow lever down and the red knob on the side pushed out, the motor runs the compressor, a crank pumping the pneumatic pump that fills the crane's air system.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 43 (bottom left) and page 44 (top left: the pump running)
functions.note: which part is the red knob that's pushed in and out isn't identified; the pump p378 99798-f1 is drawn retracted and its stroke isn't expressed

functions.does: With the yellow lever down and the red knob pushed in, the motor works a fourth output.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 43 (bottom right: the crane's grab moving up and down)
functions.note: unsure what this output does: the picture shows the grab moving up and down with the crane reaching over the cab

functions.does: The first valve on the crane base works the cylinder that raises and lowers the crane's main boom.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 44 (top right: a valve lever and the boom swinging); book 5 pages 6-12 (boom and cylinder); inferred: which valve is which
functions.note: worked in the set with a valve (p2282, p2560 or p3196, 47223a-f1) after pumping; the cylinder's parts stand in as the control

functions.does: The second valve works the cylinder that swings the crane's outer arm with the grab up and down.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 44 (bottom left); book 5 pages 13-16
functions.note: worked in the set with a valve after pumping; the cylinder's parts stand in as the control

functions.does: The third valve works the small cylinder that opens and closes the grab's jaws.
functions.source: book: book 5 page 44 (bottom right); book 5 pages 17-20 (the grab)
functions.note: worked in the set with a valve after pumping; the jaw parts aren't identified

functions.does: The black gears at the two sides of the crane's subframe swing the striped stabiliser legs down to the ground or up for driving.
functions.source: book: book 4 page 38 step 10 and pages 47-48 (legs, gears and links); inferred: how they're worked

functions.does: The cab tilts forward on hinges at its front, showing the engine.
functions.source: book: book 4 page 17 step 52 (a hand tilting the cab forward)
functions.note: inferred which parts are the cab

functions.does: A fourth valve on the truck, by the gearbox, is part of the air system.
functions.source: inferred: a fourth valve p826 47223a-f1 sits on the truck by the gearbox

questions.question: What does the fourth motor output do, and the truck valve p826? Is the steering wheel linked?
